question: Who was the chief guest at the first Republic Day celebration of India in 1950?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukarno**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukarno** was the chief guest at the first Republic Day celebration of India in 1950.
 
• Sukarno was the first President of Indonesia and a prominent leader in the Indonesian struggle for independence from the Dutch colonial rule.
 
• The invitation of Sukarno as the chief guest underscored the close relations between India and Indonesia, both of which were newly independent nations at the time.
 
• The first Republic Day celebration marked the adoption of the Constitution of India and the transition of India from a British Dominion to a republic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949 **and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written **constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Republic Day** is celebrated every year on **26th January** to honor the date on which the Constitution of India came into effect.
